groupIntro.captcha: CAPTCHA (pre-verification for the verification-code endpoint, blocking distributed code-scraping scripts): Cloudflare Turnstile (default, free; create a widget in the Cloudflare dashboard for the site key and secret key) or Aliyun Captcha 2.0 (scene ID from "Scene Management", identity prefix from "Overview"; a dedicated RAM sub-account with only AliyunYundunAFSFullAccess is recommended). Toggle it on the "Security Policy" page; fill in the credentials of the selected provider first.
groupIntro.cluster: Cluster join parameters for one-command GPU node onboarding: the server address and join token come from the server node (use the dedicated agent token — the agent-token value in the server config; NEVER use node-token, which can pull the node into the etcd ring. Update here after rotation). The distro is auto-detected by the platform (see the "Cluster" page), no need to declare it; registries.yaml is auto-generated from the server address — this key is an advanced override, leave it empty. Once configured, ops generates a one-time enrollment command under "Nodes & GPU → Add Node".
groupIntro.compliance: Filing info is shown in the user-side footer. The ICP filing is submitted via your access provider (cloud vendor); fill in the full filing number (including suffixes like -1) once issued; the public-security filing is applied at beian.mps.gov.cn within 30 days of going live. Company identity (name/address/phone/license link) is a disclosure item per Article 15 of the E-Commerce Law, shown persistently in the footer; leave empty to hide the corresponding line.
groupIntro.email: Verification emails (sign-up, sign-in, password reset, contact binding) are delivered over SMTP. Fill in the server, transport security, account and sender, then verify with the test send below. The mock provider only logs (fixed code 123456) and is refused in production.
groupIntro.observability: The admin node page renders its own metric curves and does not depend on Grafana. For deep dives (custom dashboards, long-range comparison), configure a Grafana URL here and an "Open in Grafana" link will appear on the node page (no iframe embedding).
groupIntro.payment_alipay: Alipay face-to-face payment (precreate QR, RSA2): create an app on the open platform (open.alipay.com) and sign up for "face-to-face payment"; under Development Settings → Signing, choose public-key mode: generate the app private key with the key tool (fill in below), upload the app public key, then paste back the platform-generated "Alipay public key". The async notify URL {public_base_url}/api/v1/webhooks/alipay is carried by the order request.
groupIntro.payment_wechat: WeChat Pay APIv3 (Native QR): on the merchant platform (pay.weixin.qq.com) → Account Center → API Security, download the merchant API certificate/private key and set the APIv3 secret. Then request the "WeChat Pay public key" and fill in both the public key ID and the public key (the only verification mode; the channel is unavailable unless both are set). The payment callback URL is {public_base_url}/api/v1/webhooks/wechatpay, carried by the order request — no separate merchant-side configuration needed.
groupIntro.real_name: Aliyun real-person verification · three-factor mobile check (simple, Mobile3MetaSimpleVerify): activate the "factor verification" service and authorize a RAM sub-account. A passed check marks the user as verified; the ID number is stored only as a masked string, the plaintext is discarded immediately. Whether it is enabled, and whether it is required before top-up, are toggled on the "Security Policy" page.
groupIntro.registry: Harbor is the authoritative source for platform and tenant instance images: create a platform project (default superdl) and a robot account with Pull + List Repository only, then fill in host, project, robot and secret; for self-signed certificates paste the CA (used by node-join on nodes and by platform probing). Pull credentials never land on nodes: before creating Pods or prewarming, the worker writes the superdl-registry-pull Secret into the superdl and tenant namespaces by fingerprint — rotation is just saving a new secret here. Docker Hub and other public registries can be accelerated via Harbor proxy-cache projects (one upstream=project per line, keep the project public). After saving, verify with "Test connection" below.
groupIntro.security: Runtime switches for security features: off skips the corresponding check; before enabling, fill in the credentials on the respective channel pages (the feature fails closed with 502 when credentials are missing). Turning a switch off in production is allowed but means giving up that line of defense — a reason is required when saving (recorded in the audit log).
groupIntro.sms: SMS channel: Aliyun dysmsapi (registered signature and templates; a dedicated RAM sub-account is recommended) or Twilio Messages (Account SID / Auth Token / sender). Switching the provider takes effect immediately; verify with the test send below.
groupIntro.support: Support contacts are shown in the user-side footer and on the "Help & Support" page. Leave empty to hide the corresponding entry — GPU rental has a high user-education cost, and having no contact channel blocks every issue outside the ticket system.
